finding.title: Per-car manifest ownership is not independently checked
finding.evidence: verify_recovered_asset_index.check validates each row/document car name, asset counts, file bytes and hashes, path uniqueness, category totals, and equality between the global manifest path set and a global producer-receipt path set. It does not verify that each manifest's assets are the ones assigned to that car by producer receipts.
finding.adversarial_reproduction: In a disposable temporary overlay, swapped the original_model asset records between 49_COUPE and F100_1956 manifests while preserving each manifest's size and category counts, recalculated those two manifest hashes in a copied index, and ran the unchanged check(index). It returned cars=35, assets=2579, producer_receipt_set_equality=true. The asset hashes and global path set stayed valid, while both per-car model associations became wrong.
finding.impact: The committed/current output is verified against current bytes and its builder appears to assign paths from the producer records. However, the validator can accept internally rehashed per-car manifests that exchange same-kind assets across cars, so it does not independently validate the advertised car-to-asset association. The current negative control exercises only manifest-hash corruption.
finding.recommended_fix: Derive expected asset records per car from the producer receipts (including expected paths and source hashes where present) and compare each manifest's complete path-to-kind/metadata mapping with that per-car set. Add the demonstrated cross-car swap as a negative control.

results.claim: The verifier checks each asset's per-car ownership against producer receipts.
The current index has 35 cars and 2,579 individually hash-verified assets, and the verifier reports producer_receipt_set_equality=true.
The existing negative test rejects a changed manifest hash but does not test cross-car ownership swaps.

jev_typesafe.interpretation: Jev confirmed the code-coverage statements. Deterministic source inspection and the disposable adversarial execution establish the defect; the model judgment is corroboration, not the basis of the finding.

limitations: The validation command rewrites research/evidence/continuation/source-refresh/recovered-asset-index-validation.json; its observed hash is recorded above.
This audit did not modify either reviewed tool or any recovered manifest/index.
This review does not certify final in-game render equivalence or independently validate all producer parsers.
